name: Do I need an electrician to install a bedroom night light?

mainEntity.name: Do I need an electrician to install a bedroom night light?

acceptedAnswer.text: For most plug-in night lights, no electrician is needed as they simply plug into an existing outlet. However, if you're installing hardwired fixtures, such as wall-mounted or recessed lights that require connecting to your home's electrical system, it's highly recommended to use a licensed electrician. This ensures the installation is safe, up to code, and properly grounded, preventing potential fire hazards or electrical issues. Professional installation also often includes warranty protection.
acceptedAnswer.description: An electrician is recommended for hardwired night lights requiring connection to your home's electrical system to ensure safety and code compliance.
